items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: And so after we were discharged and working with this monster pianist for six months I decided to give that a shot.

ctx.x: Yeah. But I did it in such a nice way, the man had changed completely, he was a different person. He had had some problems in his childhood that reflected in his daily living so I understand that. No problem. But anyway this experience lasted for about three years, this military experience. And I became — got out. But just before getting out I met a fellow by the name of Oscar Tunnard. Oscar was supposed to be one of these brainy guys that could remember everything. He played that way. He was from St. Petersburg…
